_about: Sky Script v1 (7 Oct 2026), trained from Top-100 #1 (r11, Mohmd.Visuals, podcast clip, score 9). A clean podcast talking head with stacked mixed-size ITALIC captions (tiny white italic lead words, one huge bold italic hero word in cyan), cut with light sky-blue gradient pages: a 3D object with a small italic label, photo cards with an orange pill tag (one card per spoken item, swapped on the word), and a bold italic word card in navy. Fast but airy: a picture change every ~1.7 s. Natural colour, no heavy grade.

director.style: Sky Script: a clean podcast clip with stacked italic captions (tiny white lead words, ONE huge bold italic cyan hero) and light sky-blue gradient pages that explain the idea. Airy, smart, premium; natural colour.
director.captions: captions.heroes: list a content word for nearly EVERY phrase (the idea words: nouns, verbs, numbers), never filler ('here', 'number', 'having', 'really'); phrases without a listed hero stay small. Lowercase, italic, centred under the chin.
director.pages: Every page uses the sky gradient: popcard stage linear-gradient(160deg, #FFFFFF 0%, #DDF6FE 40%, #2BD3FA 100%); scene pages (cardpage, wordpage) paper linear-gradient(160deg, #FFFFFF 0%, #DDF6FE 22%, #2BD3FA 50%) (scene backgrounds are drawn at 220% size). Three kinds: (1) popcard object (a cut-out object PNG) with a 1-4 word lowercase italic label, 1.0-1.8 s; (2) cardpage with tags: true, tagColor #FF7A1A, ratio 0.72, w 760, one photo per spoken item (items [{src, tag, at}]), swapped on the word; (3) wordpage bg paper with paper = the gradient, the payoff word in navy, size 120, 0.5-0.9 s.
director.rhythm: A page every ~3-4 s, hard cut in and out; punch-ins (cadence target 36/min) fill the rest. Spread evenly, no stretch over 3 s without a change.
director.stock: Photos must be on-topic and people-friendly (no soldiers, disasters, paintings); look at every still before using it.
director.dont: No dark grade, no neon, no glow, no red text.
